name: greeter
description: A small stateless HTTP service with a single GET /hello endpoint that returns a JSON greeting for an optional `name` query parameter, defaulting to "World" when omitted. Follows the Go service layout and conventions from app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference: cmd/greeter/main.go entrypoint, internal/ package for logic, stdlib net/http, JSON errors, PORT env var. It does not persist data, require authentication, or expose any other endpoint.
